thread:
Alex Chen: spinning up yvr1 GPU pool — need kernel/driver compatibility validation + a throughput baseline. planning a short quick-pass now, full 4h soak tomorrow.
Mira Patel: what's the GPU SKU and node image?
Alex Chen: A100 80GB (NVLink), 8 nodes initial. image= rwd-inference-2026-02
Sandeep Rao: target driver = 535.XX, cuda=12.2. also confirm libnvidia-ml and rmm versions.
infra-bot: deploy job queued: infra-deploy/1992006789 -> yvr1 (8 nodes)
Mira Patel: smoke checks to run on each host: `uname -r; modinfo nvidia | head -n 5; dmesg | grep -i nvrm` and `nvidia-smi -q`.
Alex Chen: quick command bundle:
```
for h in $(cat yvr1-nodes.txt); do
  ssh $h "echo --- $h ---; uname -r; modinfo nvidia | head -n 3; nvidia-smi -q | grep 'Driver Version'";
done
```
Sandeep Rao: also verify PCIe and IOMMU settings: `cat /proc/cmdline` should have `intel_iommu=on` or `iommu=pt` depending on BIOS. we hit hangs before if absent.
Mira Patel: throughput tool config (short-run):
`rwd-bench --model small-llama --batch 16 --seq 1024 --duration 600 --workers 4 --out json`
Alex Chen: rough expectations: ~350 tokens/s per GPU sustained on this stack; p95 latency (batch=1 fast-path) <250ms. we'll log raw traces.
ops-runner: kicking off 10m quick-pass across 3 nodes now, will paste logs.
ops-runner: quick-pass update: node yvr1-03 failed driver load on boot: "nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol nvidia_pci_register_driver"
Sandeep Rao: that error looks like mixed kernel modules. run `dkms status` and check `/lib/modules/$(uname -r)` for stale nvidia modules.
Mira Patel: i'm SSHing to yvr1-03. found leftover modules under `/lib/modules/5.15/extra` from previous image. removing stale files and re-run DKMS install fixes it.
Alex Chen: after DKMS fix, re-run the smoke commands and bench on yvr1-03.
ops-runner: re-run finished, short bench snippet:
```
node yvr1-01: tokens/s=362 p95(1)=218ms
node yvr1-02: tokens/s=359 p95(1)=225ms
node yvr1-03: tokens/s=348 p95(1)=238ms
```
Mira Patel: good, within tolerance. next: long-duration soak with cold/warm cache toggles and KV cache enabled. also validate prefix caching behavior.
Sandeep Rao: add profiling flags if we need kernel traces: `--trace-kernel` but note overhead. for nvlink perf issues, enable `--nvprof-collect` selectively.
Alex Chen: ops/finance note: initial 8-node on-demand price ~ $7.2/hr/node -> ~ $1.5k/mo if kept at minimal utilization. raising ENGINFRA ticket for reserved pricing discussion.
ops-runner: scheduling 4h soak and handoff to oncall tomorrow 09:00 PT. runbook link: https://internal.redwood/infra/runbooks/yvr1-compat
Mira Patel: please ensure node metadata captures driver version, kernel, dkms fixes and any BIOS tweaks. we'll include in cluster-init PR.
Alex Chen: thanks team :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deployment update: 7/8 nodes healthy; 1 node flapped and auto-recovered. Monitoring alert suppressed for the duration of handoff window.
Mira Patel: closing quick-pass. will reopen if soak surfaces regressions.
